errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled "Стойности на EGDI" (Values of EGDI) and shows decimal values. There is no mention of percentages on the chart.
The y-axis scale shown in the chart ranges from 0.5000 to 0.9500. The description incorrectly uses data point values as the axis range.

errors.text_span: Първата линия, обозначена с червен цвят и пунктирана, показва EGDI на ЕС
errors.evidence: The line for the EU is blue and solid, not red and dashed. The description incorrectly identifies one of the red dashed trend lines as the EU data line.
The starting value for the EU line in 2012 is 0.7483. The value 0.7556 corresponds to the year 2016 for the EU.

errors.text_span: Втората линия, обозначена с червен цвят и червена линия, показва EGDI на България
errors.evidence: The line for Bulgaria (BG) is orange and solid, not red. The description incorrectly identifies the other red dashed trend line as the Bulgaria data line.
The starting value for the Bulgaria (BG) line in 2012 is 0.6132, not 0.6312.

The description completely fails to mention the actual data lines (blue solid line for EU, orange solid line for BG) and their specific trends, including the notable dip for both series in 2014. It only describes the red dashed lines.

errors.text_span: Линията преминава с малък лек наклон нагоре през периода.
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization that ignores the actual data for the EU, which shows a dip from 0.7483 in 2012 to 0.7300 in 2014 before rising again.

errors.text_span: Линията преминава с нарастващ наклон нагоре през периода.
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization that ignores the actual data for Bulgaria, which shows a significant dip from 0.6132 in 2012 to 0.5421 in 2014 before rising.
The phrasing "red color and red line" is redundant.
